description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Fetch and read the web] Parses a feed URL, or finds the feed linked from a page (falls back to /feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml), and returns normalised items with title, link, ISO date, summary and author, plus feed title and type. Input: url, optional limit 1-100. Limits: 5 MB, 10 s per request, up to 4 requests; robots.txt obeyed for every URL and redirect. Cached 10 min.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

name: feed_parse

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.
